answer.summary: All 3 UpdateInject.test.tsx tests fail with a deterministic TypeError: helper.getPlatformSettings is not a function, raised from isFeatureEnabled in utils.ts when UpdateInject.tsx (touched by this change) renders. The test's helper mock likely lacks getPlatformSettings. Re-running will repeat this. The many MissingTranslationError lines are log noise from other passing suites and are not the cause.
